treatment: P2 only, four contracted procurement decisions in one distributor. Local means within the simulated sub-Saharan Africa region. Two food slots exchange consideration order; both materials slots keep their position. The native implementation uses an equivalent temporary cash floor for the Kern order which is then restored; native iteration order is unchanged. All four actual quantities must equal independently recomputed cheaper-first quantities.
units: One food parcel supports one person for four weeks. Exact monetary integers are micros (1,000,000 per modeled dollar). Regional households are scenario aggregates.
